Registration fee €30 per tra ctor. Cunamh Iveragh greatly appreciates your continued support for our Respite home for adults with intellectual Disabilities in Cahirciveen. Solicitor Colm Kelly is giving a free information session in the O’Connell Centre Cahersiveen on Mon Nov 23rd at 4 pm on “Enduring Power of Attorney”. Christ the King! When all is said and done, what really matters in life is not what we have, but how we have lived and how we have treated one another. At the end of another Church year, the Feast of Christ the King invites us to think about our priorities. Jesus points towards something much simpler: love, kindness, forgiveness and care for one another. Last weekend, we remembered those who died during the past year. Each one had a story, a family, friendships and a special place in the lives of others. Their passing reminds us how precious life is and how important it is to make the most of the time we have together. Perhaps the greatest tribute we can pay to those we remember is to carry something of their goodness into our lives. A little more patience, a little more kindness and a little more time for one another can make a difference. This, after all, is the kind o f life Christ our King asks us to live. Valentia
